subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures with `includeDetails: true` be hidden from user-visible payloads, or should cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose detail warnings remain visible?
rationale: Current tests encode useful detail-mode diagnostics, while the linked issue asks for suppress-all behavior; choosing between those policies is maintainer intent, not a mechanical code-review call.

options.title: Clarify Policy Before Merge
options.body: Hold this branch until a maintainer chooses the includeDetails policy, then require code and tests to match that policy before merge.

options.title: Suppress All Exec-Like Warnings
options.body: Approve the requested behavior and repair the patch by moving exec-like suppression before mutating handling with focused regression coverage.

options.title: Preserve Detail Diagnostics
options.body: Keep current cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose detail warnings and narrow or close the linked issue instead of merging this branch.

recommendation.title: Clarify Policy Before Merge
recommendation.body: Hold this branch until a maintainer chooses the includeDetails policy, then require code and tests to match that policy before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has recent tool-mutation ownership signals and merged the adjacent exec warning-formatting work, making them the best available routing candidate for the policy choice.
